page.layout: One printed page (left page of the opening, text column in the centre-left); a narrow column of marginal notes on the right edge, mostly cut off by the scan and illegible, not transcribed; a catchword "tio" at the lower right of the text block.

main_text.p: ftiferum illud Idolum, quod Principatui tam magnificum effinxerat Superftitio, & cui tot anhela fuspiria necquicquam immolaverat Ambitio: nec defunt de circumfusa plebe, qui nobiscum sentiant, extemporales Philosophi. Videtur etiam exercitio hoc, violentos illos spiritus sedari posse, qui quandoque intra depressæ & angustæ sortis cavernas indignantes, moliuntur irruptionem cum strage, & ad invertendum Reipublicæ statum, turbulento feruntur impetu: His si detur in Cothurnum erigere se, & in Heroica quædam crepitacula effutire, videntur sibi inani istâ specie, naturalem amplitudinem consecuti: Et tantisper laxati, imposterum concutiunt & quassant mitiùs.
Contrà. Compendiosus ad insaniam juventuti trames, exercitatio

page.notes: The marginal notes on the right edge are cut off and largely illegible; not transcribed. The catchword "tio" is given in the text as the last word of the final line, as printed at the lower right. Faint show-through from the facing page is ignored. Ligature "ffi" in "effinxerat" and long s throughout are as printed.
